$doc: E387 progress cameras for scripts/shard-progress.mjs: the loop builders' hero views (H1 Sunrest rim, H2 the windmill isle, H3 the high step, H4 the crown) plus two aerials and an orbit clip. Keep them fixed: the time-lapse lines frames up by id. yaw / pitch in degrees (yaw 0 faces -z). E399: one mock-* view per council mockup (docs/plans/mockup-council/ledger.md), at the mockup's camera: proposal B and mockup A down the spawn bridge to the windmill, B the quest start at the spawn (the keeper left of the axis), C the fan with the windmill behind, D the crown arena under the Roc. The spawn mock views come before the crown (its boss bar) and the aerials (a god view hides the viewmodel). Re-aimed to the mockups' cameras (E399 round notes): B 5.5 m from the keeper with the windmill just right of him; proposal B, A and C on the bridge's axis before its posts, out of the keeper's 3.5 m talk range and the phone's ~24 deg-wide frame; D from 18 m before the dais, the Roc staged mid-stalk over the dais (stage 'roc-stalk', settle 0.3 s). Round-1 notes: mock-C re-aimed to its own camera (right of the bridge head, the near post 12 deg left, the bridge running away diagonally) and stages 'fan-gust' (the fan held at its GUST thrust); h4-crown stages 'quest-crown' (the quest a player has in the arena: finished, the bridge raised, the reward paid), so its toasts are gone by mock-D; mock-D stages 'roc-stalk' with its creatures active (calm false). Round-2 notes: mock-C re-aimed 3.5 m right of the bridge axis, 10 m back, so the right bridge-head post sits at the frame's left quarter with the bridge running away from it and the windmill centred (the mockup's framing; the portrait view is ~24 deg wide; the keeper stays out of frame). mock-B re-aimed 5.6 m from the keeper on the line from him to the windmill (the mockup's framing: the keeper and his stand at the left third, the windmill right of centre). Round-2 rulings: mock-C stages nothing (the 'fan-gust' freeze is gone; the fan is in its idle hold) and is re-aimed to (2.3, -11.6) yaw 7 so the bridge deck runs away left of the near post, as mockup C shows it. Round-2 seat B: mock-B 9 m from the keeper (the mockup's HUD reads 'KEEPER 9 M'), (-0.3, -4.8) yaw 4; mock-C ~5 m from the right bridge-head post at (3.2, -11.0) yaw 12 (between seat B's 'a third of the mockup's size' and the inner seat's 'fills the left third'), the post at the left of the frame and the deck running away beside it (the mockup's size); mock-proposal-B its own camera, at Sunrest's rim right of the bridge head (4.0, -14.6) yaw 9 pitch -13, looking along the hanging bridge and down over the drop; mock-D's Roc staged 27 m past the dais on the same stalk line, so it shows under the boss bar. mock-D pulled back to the arena's south rim (z -172.5, pitch 4), so the whole dais and the five stones sit in the lower middle, as mockup D frames them. mock-proposal-B stands on the new grassy rise at the bridge head (KNOLL, 1.4 m, walkable), looking down along the hanging bridge to the windmill isle, as proposal B does. Round-4 rulings: the KNOLL moved to (7.6, -11.5), out from under mock-C's camera (C stands on the meadow again); mock-proposal-B moved onto it (7.6, 31.4, -11.5) yaw 8; mock-D's Roc staged ON its 13 m circle (3 m west of the dais's far side). Round-6 notes: the high step moved 36 m west (layout STEP, out from behind the windmill, which no mockup shows), so h3 (a hero view, no mockup) turned from yaw -2.5 to 30 to keep framing it from the same spot; no other mock-* view changed. Round 6 (the seats, rounds 4-5: 'from 7.6 m east of the axis the deck enters from the left and the isle fills the width; standing on the knoll does not reproduce the target camera'): the KNOLL moved onto the bridge's axis behind the spawn (0, 3), 2.4 m high, and mock-proposal-B onto its top (0, 32.4, 3) yaw 0 pitch -10, looking straight down the bridge, as proposal B does. A second rise at the crown arena's south side (layout KNOLLS crown, (0, -177.5), 2.4 m; every seat: 'a thin distant platform' where mockup D looks down on a broad dais): mock-D stands by its top (0, 46.4, -176) pitch 5 (the dais at y 0.61-0.66 and the stones at 0.51-0.58 of the frame, as the mockup has them), 20 m from the dais and ~4 m above it, as the mockup's camera looks down into the arena; mock-C turned 7 deg right (yaw 12 to 5; the seats, rounds 4-5: 'the near post is large at x 0.28-0.45; the mockup's is at the left margin, x 0.06-0.2'), so the post stands at the frame's left edge and the windmill near the middle, as the mockup has them; h4 3.5 m further in (0, 46.3, -175.5), on the rise, inside the boss's arena (18 m from the crown's centre; at 18.0 it stood on the edge) and the crown's discovery ring (15 m), so the Roc's intro and the place toast play during its 12 s settle as they do for a player walking in, and D shows the fight.
